body:
Mira Murati is a technology executive who served as chief technology officer of OpenAI and then co-founded the AI company Thinking Machines Lab with other OpenAI alumni. The company raised a US$2 billion seed round at a US$12 billion valuation within its first five months.

Why she is in the news

Thinking Machines Lab has been the subject of continuing funding reports, including talks of a much larger valuation that reportedly did not close in January 2026 and September 2026 reports of a US$1 billion round at a US$40 billion valuation.

What she leads

Thinking Machines released its first product, Tinker, a service that helps developers fine-tune AI models. See our explainer on Thinking Machines Lab for the funding timeline.

What is not covered yet

This draft deliberately omits her early life, education and the dates of her OpenAI career until they are checked against primary sources, and it leaves out age, family and wealth estimates.
